{{Quote|THAT VECTOR PLATE IS ALREADY WARPED, AND THE ENGINE NACELLES ARE READY TO MELT.|Ninette, to Ben Skywalker and Tahiri Veila, while under attack from Mandalorians|<ref name="Crucible">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>}}
A '''vector plate''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] component constructed from [[Metal/Legends|metal]]. [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapan]] [[Miy'tari Scout]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] were fitted with vector plates. In [[45 ABY]], a Miy'tari Scout operated by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Ben Skywalker]] and [[Tahiri Veila]] and the [[R9-series astromech droid]] [[Ninette]] came under [[Ambush at Ohali Soroc's supposed crash site|heavy fire]] from [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]]-operated ''[[Bes'uliik]]'' fighters in the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]], causing the vessel's port-side vector plate to warp and melt.<ref name="Crucible" />
 
==Behind the scenes==
Vector plates appeared in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Crucible" />
